purpose: Reduced-surface same-runner paired measurement feasibility pilot. Methodological pilot only; not production-equivalent CI and not a W3.2 campaign.

case.note: A real contract decision on the pinned tree. Full selected arm would be required union comprehensive; this pilot projects both arms onto the frozen reduced surface below.

controls.host_validation: before any runner invocation; fail closed

criteria.host: measured production class: Ubuntu 26.04.1, image ubuntu26:20261122.9.1, x86_64/X64, AMD EPYC, 4 cores, memory in [15500000,17500000] kB, Racket 8.10 SHA-256 7674f17865fa795b21641828d839e689e01a2f17bbdd2b7d71cc59cceafa873c
criteria.integrity: every invocation rc=0; selected arm exactly the two projected files; comprehensive arm exactly the eight frozen files; all statuses pass; zero timeouts/failures/missing
criteria.pairing: one warm-up per arm plus three measured pairs in the frozen alternating order; all individual walls, selection overheads, test counts and statuses recorded
criteria.isolation: one runner process per invocation, no shards, no nested runner, dispatch-only workflow
criteria.provenance: host identity, cache state, preparation, exact argv, per-run wall, load and selection decision digest recorded
criteria.analysis: report S = 1 - (selected wall + selection overhead) / comprehensive wall for every pair; no threshold or GO from S; incomplete or degraded observations remain unavailable
